state_migration_negative_result.finding: The current migration helper executed migration files via sqlite3.executescript() and only committed/rolled back later; Python sqlite3 documents executescript implicit transaction behavior, so a late script failure was not safely covered by the outer rollback assumption.
state_migration_negative_result.architecture_decision: Atomicity is required per physical database. Cross-file UnifiedDB+ClayGraph atomic truth is not claimed because UnifiedDB is authority and ClayGraph is derived; interrupted/divergent pairs must fail closed and graph state must be rebuildable.

f6_model_boundary_negative_result.finding: The initial F6 adapter validated only the starting endpoint host and used urllib.request.urlopen(), allowing an admitted loopback HTTP endpoint to redirect to a non-loopback sandbox address. The redirected destination received the request.

live_research_constraints.python_sqlite_executescript: Implicit commit semantics make transaction boundaries explicit engineering state, not an assumption.
live_research_constraints.sqlite_attached_db: Multi-database atomicity has journal-mode/main-db constraints; do not casually treat two SQLite files as one crash-atomic transaction.
